name: multi_ema_ribbon_squeeze
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 60s, 3-min, and 5-min EMAs compress into a band tighter than ~0.06% of index level (~13 spot points at 22000), all near-term participants — scalpers, momentum algos, and institutional TWAP bots — are simultaneously in equilibrium with no directional edge. When price breaks decisively through this compressed ribbon on above-average volume, it signals that a directional institutional order has started absorbing the resting supply (bullish) or demand (bearish). At 5-second resolution, we enter within the first 15-30 seconds of the expansion, before the 1-minute bar closes and slower systems react, capturing the initial 15-25 spot point thrust.

indicators.name: ema_12
indicators.purpose: 60-second fast EMA — NOT 9×12=108 (blind scale). At 5s bars, 12 bars is the shortest window that smooths sub-minute tick noise on NIFTY while still being responsive to short-term direction. This is the squeeze trigger: when ema_12 converges with the slower EMAs, scalpers have no edge.

indicators.name: ema_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute medium EMA — represents the primary timeframe that intraday algo strategies and momentum traders reference. When ema_36 aligns with ema_12 and ema_60, it confirms multi-timescale equilibrium, not just tick noise. This is the most important context filter.

indicators.name: ema_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute slow EMA — NIFTY's dominant intraday trend is visible at 5-min resolution. Used as the slow anchor of the ribbon. NOT 50×12=600 bars (50-min EMA, too slow for 30-90s holds). 5-min is the longest context meaningful for a 90-second trade.

indicators.name: ribbon_squeeze
indicators.formula: (max(ema_12, ema_36, ema_60) - min(ema_12, ema_36, ema_60)) / min(ema_12, ema_36, ema_60) < squeeze_threshold
indicators.purpose: Detects multi-EMA compression phase. Threshold of ~0.06% corresponds to ~13 spot points at NIFTY 22000 — a genuinely narrow range where all three timescales agree on price level.

indicators.name: vol_sma_20
indicators.purpose: 20-bar (100s) volume baseline. Breakout volume must exceed this baseline to confirm institutional participation, not a random noise break.

conditions: ribbon_squeeze was True on previous bar (squeeze just ended)
close > max(ema_12, ema_36, ema_60) — price breaks above ribbon
volume > vol_ratio_min * vol_sma_20 — above-average volume on breakout
buy_ce.confirmation: Squeeze must have been present on the prior bar; same-bar squeeze+breakout is filtered as instantaneous noise

conditions: ribbon_squeeze was True on previous bar (squeeze just ended)
close < min(ema_12, ema_36, ema_60) — price breaks below ribbon
volume > vol_ratio_min * vol_sma_20 — above-average volume on breakdown
buy_pe.confirmation: Same one-bar lag applied to ensure genuine break, not a momentary wick through the ribbon

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 spot pts move against position. When NIFTY breaks a tight EMA ribbon, a valid expansion should not retrace 8 spot pts within 30 seconds — if it does, the breakout is a fakeout and the squeeze will re-establish. Tighter than 4 pts risks noise stops; wider than 4 pts allows too much adverse drift on a 30-90s thesis.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 spot pts, which is roughly 50-60% of the first expansion leg after an EMA squeeze on NIFTY (typical first thrust: 20-30 spot pts over 60-90 seconds). This gives 1:1.75 risk-reward and is achievable within the 90-second time stop.

filters.vix_filter: none — EMA ribbon squeeze works in both trending and range regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST; skip first 5 minutes of opening noise
filters.trend_filter: none — strategy is self-contained; the ribbon alignment is the trend filter

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — if more algos detect the same squeeze pattern, signal frequency drops but surviving signals remain valid

adaptation_notes: Original used 9/21/50 EMAs on 1-min equity bars with 30-100 bar holds (30-100 min). Converted to 12/36/60 EMAs on 5s index bars with 18-bar (90s) holds. Lookbacks NOT blindly 12x scaled — instead chosen to represent 60s/3min/5min timescales meaningful for a 90-second trade. The 5-min EMA (60 bars) replaces the 50-min (original ema_50 on 1-min) because we need a slow context filter for our hold time, not the full trend anchor relevant to 30-100 minute holds. Volume filter retained but threshold relaxed (1.1× vs implied 1.2× original) because index volume is smoother than single-stock volume. ATR-based stop replaced by fixed 4pt option premium stop consistent with 5-second bar calibration.
weaknesses: Squeeze can persist for many bars (5-30 minutes) before resolving, generating few signals
EMA ribbon fakeouts common in low-liquidity NIFTY sessions (post 14:30)
On expiry days, NIFTY moves are larger and faster — 4pt stop may trigger early on valid breakouts
